RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Good winner in a black type at Delaware Park 49 days ago; on target three times in her last four outings; no surprise to see her go well.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: A proven winner with a career wins-runs record of 4-13 but all her victories have been gained at a lower level; finished fifth but wasn't beaten too far (just under 4l) back down to 1m2f (Santa Anita) 50 days ago in an allowance listed; running on dirt for the first time; a few rivals look in good form so may have to settle for supporting role at best.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: Baker Stables LLC, Michael Golovko & Terrence J Scanlan
Spotlight: Track has proven suitable before; on target three times in her last seven outings; had two of these in arrears at Santa Anita in May when springing a surpise to score by just under 4l (went off 17-2) in an allowance Grade 2.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Recent runs have been consistent; not beaten too far when third of six 49 days ago at Santa Anita in a Grade 3; she can be taken on.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Has managed nine wins from 37 career runs; respectable third in an allowance Grade 2 at Churchill Downs on first run for current trainer two months ago; can't be ruled out.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Successful three times from ten career runs; respectable effort when second in an allowance Grade 2 at Santa Anita behind Om N Joy two months ago; has won in classy company before and warrants consideration.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Beaten 28l (Los Alamitos Race Course) four weeks ago when dropped to 6 1/2f in an allowance Grade 2; not always shown an awful lot since winning a black type at Zia Park in November and has done all her winning at a lower level; a lot on her plate here and unlikely to trouble the principals.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
Spotlight: Has chalked up three wins from her last five; has scored over C&D; behind Om N Joy when third in May (Santa Anita) in an allowance Grade 2; stable going well a plus; strong contender as has some big wins on the CV.

RaceName: Clement L Hirsch Stakes Presented By Oak Tree Racing Association (Fillies & Mares) (Grade 1) (Dirt)
OwnerName: St Elias Stables LLC & WSS Racing LLC
Spotlight: Beaten sixth of seven in an allowance Grade 2 at Belmont At The Big A three months ago; has achieved four wins from 15 career runs.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Built on her debut second to shed her maiden status in comfortable style at Hamilton (6f, good to firm), drawing clear by over 4l under David Egan; steps up to 7f for her first start in Group company but enough in her pedigree to suggest she'll get this new trip.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Displayed plenty of progression from her debut at Saint-Cloud (6f, good) to win over 7f at the same track in June, when Data was over 2l back in second; won't have any problems with the trip, so should be thereabouts upped in class.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Half-sister to Prix Jean Romanet winner Quisisana for the same ownership and trainer; made a winning debut at Saint-Cloud (7f, soft ground) from Woot Woot and improved on that to finish second over this C&D in a Listed race behind an odds-on market leader; solid claims.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Beaten a head on debut at Saint-Cloud by Queen Of The Day (7f, soft) and then didn't need to repeat that level to win over that same C&D on good ground; closely matched with the Graffard filly on that meeting in June and should give a decent account.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Didn't show lots on first two starts, recording RPRs on 47 and 32 but did much better when last seen finishing second at Le Touquet over 6.5f when a tongue-tie was applied; that will need improving upon, though, and others easier to fancy at this stage of their careers.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Just over 2l behind Flying Spur on debut (7f) at Saint-Cloud but since come out and won over a mile at Clairefontaine on good to soft; clear potential to post even bigger figures but the owner's retained rider appears to prefer Yuquot.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix Six Perfections - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: More experienced than most and has shown a fine level of ability since her successful debut, twice finishing close behind subsequent Group 2 winner Tokaido in a Listed event and a Group 3; wasn't quite at her best at Mont-De-Marsan recently but step up in trip should bring about some extra.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Holds some big-race entries but finished second on debut over the C&D three weeks ago in a newcomers race for colts and geldings; should step up from that but this is a tough ask second-time out.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: First three starts came over 5f, one an AW win and another when eighth in the Group 2 Norfolk Stakes at the Royal meeting, and then ran his best race upped to this trip for a Listed event at Newbury; open to more improvement over 6f.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Picked up a 6f conditions race on debut at Chantilly (very soft) and then ran respectably behind the classy Tokaido in a C&D Group 3 here about a month ago; will have more to come and Christophe Soumillon rides for first time.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Related to plenty of winners and made a successful debut over C&D three weeks ago in a newcomers race for fillies having gone off an odds-on shot; has a Group 1 entry and would seem to be well thought of; interesting.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
OwnerName: Infinity 9 Horses, Ecurie Marzocco et al
Spotlight: Nicely bred Mehmas filly, who was narrowly beaten on debut at Chantilly (5.5f, good to firm) before winning by a short-neck at the same course upped to 6f; Group 1 entered so should be capable of even better and stablemate of Primetime Emmy.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won her first two, a 5f contest on good to soft before following up in a Listed race at Vichy (5f, soft); not disgraced in the Group 3 Albany Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot behind Light Of Dawn on first try over that trip, but work to do with that rival.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Expensive breeze-up purchase, who won a four-runner novice at Carlisle (6f, soft) on debut before posting a much-improved effort when third in the Group 3 Albany Stakes (6f, good to firm) at Royal Ascot; well entered up and one to beat if at anything near that level today.

RaceName: Prix de Cabourg - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Turf)
Spotlight: Nicely bred filly, who has won both races, a pair of 6f events at Saint-Cloud, one on good and one on good to soft, the last by 3l in good style; been off for a couple of months but another of these with a Group 1 entry; appears to be the choice of the owner's retained rider Maxime Guyon.

Thriving since joining current yard, making it 3-3 when scoring in emphatic fashion over C&D on Monday, despite taking a keen hold; hit with a 13lb rise for that so up an aggregate of 29lb since joining the yard; Conor Smithers has ridden him on all three wins and maintains the partnership here; big player.
Bumper and 2m4f maiden hurdle winner for Gordon Elliott but 0-7 chasing last season and debuts for new yard back over hurdles, over what appears an inadequate trip.

Back to form with good third in 1m4f Killarney flat handicap last month but unable to back that up at Ballinrobe five days later; 2-6 hurdling although poor handicap debut effort at Cork in April when last seen in that discipline.

Won this 2022 & 2023 and bids for third win on the back of a fine third of 20 in Connacht Hotel QR Handicap here on Monday, staying on well after not clear run; below best on flat here on Friday, questionable whether he'll turn out for a third time this week.

Leopardstown maiden hurdle winner (2m, soft) in March and runner-up to the smart Switch From Diesel in a Punchestown novice, his best run since; 2m6f may have stretched him last time, back in trip now.

Lightly-raced 5yo won 2m2f Downpatrick maiden for Gavin Cromwell last autumn before never counting in Grade 3 at Fairyhouse; back from eight months' absence on yard/handicap debut and probably best watched.
Three-time Flat winner is 1-7 over timber, that win in a Punchestown maiden (2m1f, soft) last season; absent since poor run at Limerick over Christmas so watching brief advised, unless market speaks.
Two hurdle wins at 2m2f but has lost her way since Listowel novice chase win in September; others in better form.
Wexford handicap winner last season at this trip (yielding); hasn't completed in both chase outings, well held when faller three out at Roscommon last time; back hurdling and opposable off this mark.

In terrific form of late, winning 2m3f Market Rasen handicap hurdle in May (good) and returned from a short break when strong-finishing neck second (clear of remainder) of 19 in 2m1f flat handicap here on Wednesday; clearly handles the track, should go well.
Three Flat wins for Jessica Harrington and off the mark hurdling at eighth attempt in 2m1f Wexford handicap in May; runs since however have been modest, never counting on the flat here on Friday.

Not the force of old (one-time useful Flat handicapper) but runner-up on latest three starts in modest maiden hurdle company in Britain; twice at Stratford and most recently after making most (carrying head awkwardly, hung right) at Worcester (2m, good); handicap debut and doesn't exactly appear thrown in.
Two-time hurdles winner last year; tame chase effort here on Tuesday and tried in first-time cheekpieces now back hurdling.
12-race maiden but has shaped well on a few occasions, most notably when fourth at Leopardstown (2m2f, soft) in March; recent Wexford effort in first-time cheekpieces was okay, blinkers now tried.

Dual-purpose maiden went closest to scoring when just denied in a 2m6f novice handicap here last October (yielding) off 1lb higher; absent since December but on a nice mark and any market support could be significant, although drop in trip could be an issue.

OwnerName: Mrs Helen Mullins & M J Lomax
Spotlight: No success since a juvenile maiden hurdle win at Fairyhouse in November 2024; has dropped a long way in the ratings from an opening mark of 111 and, although recent Ballinrobe effort wasn't convincing, previous Clonmel third under today's rider offers hope; 1lb wrong.
Lightly-raced mare showed a bit of promise in a 2m3f Downpatrick mares maiden in June, but unseated in maiden at Killarney latest; handicap debut and others look more likely; 1lb wrong.

Off the mark at 28th attempt when landing 2m3f Kilbeggan handicap last month, allowed to slip the field and win unchallenged; 9lb rise okay on the face of it, but not sure if he'll back that up and 3lb out of handicap here.

Six visits here have yielded two wins and as many thirds; below her best over an extended 1m2f in last two races (also here) but she's back to Class 4 level in which she made all over C&D in May off only 2lb lower; considered, for all that an easy leads seems unlikely.
All three wins have been on the AW (1m/1m4f) but she's a consistent mare with comparable form on turf and should give her running once more (second on previous visit here); chance.

Won 11.6f and 1m6f handicaps last year for the Gosden yard; two heavy defeats over hurdles to start off with for current one but he was a 5l fourth of nine over 2m here in May and he was held up in a small field when never threatening at Newmarket last time (1m6f); back here, on a realistic mark, he could feature.

Nearly won over hurdles in May but two lesser runs followed and now 0-7 in that scene, while he's only 1-21 on the Flat (for Alan King); on a useful mark but probably not as good as he was, and he's unraced at Chester.

Record of 3-5 and it was his first time at 1m4f when making all for a convincing win at Epsom a month ago (good); that race couldn't have worked out better for him and he could be pressured this time if going from the front, but he looks progressive; up 6lb.

One of three wins came over C&D in July of last year (promoted after dead-heating); solid runs in his last three races, two at Chester; tactically versatile and should be in the mix; first-time headgear.

Progressed last year to win a 1m2f novice at Newcastle (AW); last of four on handicap debut at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) but that was after a break of 189 days and he's fully entitled to strip fitter for that; yard's runners always respected around here.
Returned from long layoff with decisive Flat win at Navan in March (heavy); okay runs both starts since in handicap hurdles but lot more needed and takes a big step up in trip.
Runner-up in 2m6f handicap at last year's festival before winning 2m2f maiden at Downpatrick (yielding); has struggled a bit since in handicaps and others look better handicapped right now.

Bumper winner; off mark at second attempt over hurdles in 2m3f Downpatrick maiden in May (good), following month tame enough effort in handicap over same C&D; back from a short break and tries a new trip.

Both wins in Britain came at around this trip on easy ground; best effort for some time on latest when front-running second in 3m Hexham handicap in June for Susan Corbett; debuts for new trainer who had a good second on the flat here on Wednesday.

Has been making hay in claiming hurdles this year and has won five of his last seven starts, most recently over this trip at Roscommon last month; front-runner back in handicap company now and interesting to see if he can be as competitive off what appears a high enough mark.

Lightly-raced 5yo ran once in France and still looks a work in progress after four starts for champion trainer, tight 2m4f in Wexford maiden last time may not have been ideal; bit to prove but improvement quite likely back at 3m.

Bumper and 2m4f maiden (Punchestown) hurdle winner; unseated two out when shaping with promise on first two chase efforts, most recently completed but again let down by jumping at Wexford; reverts to hurdles here, placings over this trip in maidens.
Maiden hurdle winner for Willie Mullins ran well in some handicaps; pulled up on yard debut after some 14 months' absence at Sligo recently; probably best watched for now.

Limerick maiden winner last year and finished good third in the Lartigue at Listowel; easily best run since and just beginning his challenge (going well) when unseating two out at Killarney in May, most recently would have gone closer but for pecking two out at same venue last month over 2m7f; remains of interest; also due to run here yeasterday (3.12).
Point-to-point and bumper winner; 0-5 hurdling, unconvincing upped in trip (2m7f) at Clonmel when last seen in April.

OwnerName: Pat Tennyson & N P Morrissey & Raymond Micheal Cody
Spotlight: 5-40 under rules, three of those have come in chases, the latest at Tramore last summer (2m6f, good); yet to hit form this year although recent 9l second to Rocky's Howya in 3m Roscommon claiming hurdle was a step in the right direction and enjoys an 8lb pull in the weights with that rival back in handicap company.

Lightly-raced 4yo ran twice in bumpers before debut hurdles win in 2m3f Kilbeggan maiden in May (good-to-yielding); soon beaten in good-class 2m1f novice here on Monday and now takes a big step up in trip for handicap debut.
Both wins have been at around 2m5f, including Kilbeggan beginners' chase last year; just okay run on latest in Wexford handicap hurdle over this trip in May; stamina remains a possible issue.

Point-to-point winner; 0-6 hurdling in Britain for Ben Brookhouse, yard debut (after long absence) in 2m6f Downpatrick handicap last month was encouraging enough and worth another shot at this trip, especially on better ground.
Won twice last year, including over this trip at Tipperary off 95; has run just three times since, tame enough Downpatrick effort on latest; blinkers now replace cheekpieces.

Progressive mare has won three of last four completed outings, including last two in 2m6f handicaps at Clonmel and when defying 7lb rise at Limerick last month in ready fashion to win going away; up a further 9lb so more needed but quite possible.

Unbeaten in two point-to-points for Michael Goff; mild promise in maiden hurdles, most recently stayed on late into modest third (to Wild Mandate) in 3m2f Sligo handicap last month (good); cheekpieces now added and could be dangerous off light weight under a more positive ride.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap
Spotlight: Off the mark at sixth attempt, coming from off the pace to lead close home in first-time blinkers at Doncaster (1m2f, good to firm) ten days ago; still unexposed over middle distances and may have more to offer.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap
Spotlight: Scored on handicap debut at Newbury in May and bounced back from a duff effort when running-on second to progressive rival at Doncaster (also 1m2f, good to firm) last month; could have untapped potential over this longer trip; respected.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Facilities Management Front Runner Handicap
Spotlight: Well beaten on handicap debut (1m2f; only run in cheekpieces) but looked a different horse when winning five-runner C&D (good to firm) contest from the front ten days ago; enjoyed the run of the race that day but was nicely clear of the others with the odds-on favourite, and a 2lb rise could turn out to be lenient.

OwnerName: Riviera Equine S A R L & Maurice Lagasse

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Promising second at Newbury (6f, good) in May and ran to a similar level when second over C&D two weeks later; absent for nine weeks since but he sets a clear standard and still has more to offer.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 210,000gns yearling; palpably green when third of ten on his debut at Newbury (6f, good to firm) last month but he kept on steadily in the closing stages; open to improvement and he's a key player.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Stayed on for third in a maiden at Kempton (6f) in June; unable to build on it at Windsor three weeks ago; others are stronger.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Poor form in two AW (7f/6f) runs this summer; can't recommend.

RaceName: British Stallion Studs EBF "Confined" Maiden Stakes (Three Runs Or Less) (GBB/IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 100-1 and offered little short-term promise at Carlisle (6f, good to firm) in June.

OwnerName: P McCormack & David P McCormack & Sarah Glynn
Spotlight: Generally runs at around 2m and won at Roscommon before running well in hurdle here on Monday; stamina for new trip is the imponderable.
Lucky to win a Tramore beginners' but then ran well in Market Rasen handicap; lapped at Perth and back from a break here.
Dotted up from the front in a Tramore beginners' over this trip and has been freshened up since.
Hunter chase winner only made it to the first when 25s for handicap debut at Wexford.
Nothing to recommend him since winning 3m hunter chase at Cork over Easter; first handicap.
Had decent form in the winter, and stays 3m, but has been struggling of late; place chance if he bounces back, and yard has had three run well here this week.
Has hit form with a chase win over 2m4f at Kilbeggan nine days ago and a belting run over hurdles (2m6f) here on Wednesday; every chance.
Landed a nice pot on heavy ground at Navan over a year ago but form has deteriorated since; long way off Golden Temple last time.
Family horse has won thrice over fences; has handled Tramore, so he might be okay around here; hurdling off lower marks lately and comes here in good shape.
Hard enough to predict but has won four handicap chases, latest over 3m1f at Punchestown in June; first visit to Galway and he's ground-versatile.

A lot of Gigginstown's have been taking flight from Mullins' yard lately, and this modest performer will probably be on his way to Doncaster sales, rather than Elliott's, before long; did plug away over 2m2f when sixth of 20 here on Tuesday.
Decent winter performer as a novice a couple of years ago, but his form has fallen off a cliff, with his mark still clinging on to the precipice; blinkers made no odds last time.

OwnerName: Paul M Butler & James Patrick Byrne
Spotlight: Dual winner over farther last summer, but old boy is hard to recommend on recent evidence.

OwnerName: Anthony N Durkan & B M Durkan
Spotlight: Not much as a hurdler, but was second in sole point and again on chase debut over this trip in Limerick handicap where tongue-tie did him no harm; top yard and rider, and can improve again.
Four point wins and snared a maiden hunter chase three years ago, but hard to fancy in a competitive handicap.

Won a point and seems to have improved markedly for having fences back in front of her; won a Downpatrick restricted beginners' by 10l and the runner-up won a handicap by the same margin next time; stays farther and plenty to like.
Mixes it between chasing and hurdling; consistent last year including C&D second over fences; a little less predictable lately, but couple of good runs at Limerick and jockey booking is noted.
Point and 3m hurdles winner was around 20l off Le Grand Vert on handicap chase debut at Punchestown (3m1f); still early days for him in this discipline.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Dead-heated on debut over 7f at Strasbourg before a couple of fair efforts, albeit none that suggest she can win at this level; others far easier to make cases for despite cheekpieces going on.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: AP Racing SC, Bernard Giraudon & Mustapha Bekhti
Spotlight: Not seen since winning on her debut at Cagnes-Sur-Mer in January over 1m2f on a standard AW surface; hard to know what to expect on first turf start following an absence but James Doyle is an eyecatching jockey booking.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: Bradley Thoroughbreds LLC, O Ghrghar & C & Y Lerner
Spotlight: Not won since 5l debut success as a 2yo but has shown steadily progressive form as she goes up in trip, and was just over 4l behind Diamond Necklace in the Prix de Diane when last seen; has to have sound claims dropped in class; now tried in cheekpieces.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Only made her debut a month ago but posted a big effort by winning by more than 4l over 1m1f on good ground; trainer well known for not over-facing his horses, so encouraging sign to see her up into a Group 3 for her second start; could be anything.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Made a successful debut on the AW at Chantilly in February but wasn't seen then until ten days ago, when a close fourth at Vichy in a Listed event (1m2f, soft); should come on from that and be involved for a place at least; tongue-tie goes on.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Won first two starts before being beaten on handicap debut; ran significantly better after that in the Sandringham Stakes at Royal Ascot on first turf run, so respected up in trip and going into a Group race for the first time; William Buick has won on her before.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
OwnerName: LNJ Foxwoods SC & Ecurie Des Monceaux
Spotlight: Chased home a Group horse on debut and then posted a big figure when landing a maiden at Longchamp (1m2f, good); not seen for three months, so hard to know what to expect, but good chance she has lots of improvement to come.

RaceName: Sky Sports Racing Prix de Psyche - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage (Group 3) (Fillies) (Turf)
Spotlight: Has done much better as a 3yo compared to her 2yo run and finished third in a 1m4f Listed event when last seen in June; drop in trip won't be a problem and looks the type to give a solid account.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Took big step forward from debut run when easily drawing clear by over 7l at Brighton (7f, good to firm) last month; that wasn't a strong race but he's an obvious contender under penalty here.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 30,000euros yearling; fourth foal; dam French 1m4f AW winner, half-sister to 1m2f Group 2 winner Ocovango and two other winners; market support will bring him into the equation.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Made fairly encouraging debut when fifth of nine at Lingfield (7f, AW) three weeks ago but has a bit to find with the principals here and might be one for a bit further down the line.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Third foal; dam 1m3f/1m4f AW winner (RPR 89), half-sister to winners Cemhaan (smart 1m-1m6f) and Moliwood (12.4f-2m); has fairly good standard to reach on debut but worth a check in the betting.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Showed clear promise over 6f on first two starts and lost out only by a head when upped to 7f at Doncaster (good to firm) a fortnight ago; that form already gives him strong claims here and further progress is possible.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 42,000euros yearling; eighth foal; half-brother to winners Promising (Group-placed 6f AW; RPR 103), Lethal Promise (5f-6f including 2yo/Listed; 102), Glen Force (1m-1m4f; 99), Kaser (8.6f-10.4f; 94) and Simple Man (5f/6f; 87); dam US 5.5f/6f winner; has nice pedigree but it's worrying to see cheekpieces fitted on debut.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: Last of ten on debut at Windsor (5f) in June and probably didn't achieve much when third of four in tactical race won comfortably by 2-9 favourite here (6f) last month; upped in trip again today.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; fifth foal; half-brother to winners Lazieelunch (1m/9.4f AW including 2yo; RPR 83), Renovatio Angel (7f 2yo; 74) and Kool Kid (bumper/jumps); dam 1m6f AW winner (79); trainer not prolific with newcomers.

RaceName: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands C/D) (EBF Restricted Race Qualifier) (GBB Race)
Spotlight: First foal; unraced dam closely related to 1m 2yo winner Luzon Heights, half-sister to winners Alobayyah (useful 1m including 2yo), Alexej (7f/7.5f) and Exceedingly Regal (1m), out of 7f 2yo Group 3 winner; stable enjoying good season with 2yos.

OwnerName: Middleham Park Racing Cxx & M Parker
Spotlight: Won a valuable sales race at last season's Ebor meeting; improved performer this year, winning a Listed event at Newbury (6f, good) before a close seventh in the Commonwealth Cup at Royal Ascot; disappointed at Newbury two weeks ago when reportedly finding the ground too fast; a penalty could leave him vulnerable today.
Five wins in a busy 2yo campaign, notably the Listed Two-Year-Old Trophy at Redcar (6f, good to soft) in October; retains ability but others bring stronger claims.

Progressive sprinter; chased home Jazl in a Newmarket handicap last month (2lb worse off today) before improving his flawless C&D record to 3-3 with an easy win eight days ago; worth his place in this stronger company and he looks sure to go well once again.

Beaten favourite in both 2yo starts; gelded prior to his reappearance at Windsor (6f, good to firm) and he showed his true colours, recording a comfortable success; followed up in a Leicester handicap in May and was a leading fancy for the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot, only to completely blow out; back on the up with a hard-fought neck defeat of Calico Blue at Newmarket last month; remains a sprinter of interest.

2-2 as a 2yo, following his debut success in a novice at Thirsk (6f, good) with a ready win in the Group 2 Gimcrack at York (6f, good to firm) last August; that form hasn't worked out and his subsequent absence is a slight concern; has the highest BHA rating in the field but he's drawn widest and there are grounds for taking him on.

OwnerName: Exors Of The Late Sheikh Mohammed Obaid
Spotlight: Chased home Lifeplan in the Gimcrack last August; well beaten in Group 2/Group 1 events so far this year; this drop in class could revive his fortunes but he is up against some progressive sorts.
Didn't need to improve on his 2yo form to win a conditions event at Wolverhampton (6f) in April; backward steps twice since and he needs a subsequent gelding operation to spark improvement.

Kept good company as a 2yo, winning Group 3 Princess Margaret Stakes at Ascot (6f, good); unplaced in four runs this year but her close fifth in the Commonwealth Cup was a personal best; down the field at York last month but she raced alone towards the stands' side and that isn't the run to judge her on; big player.
Progressive this year before struggling in the Palace Of Holyroodhouse at Royal Ascot 44 days ago; won't mind stepping back up to 6f but a big personal best will be needed to win.

Handicap mark has been remarkably static for the past two years and he's just in that 'twilight zone' where he's difficult to place; they don't often run him in handicap chases and he's been pulled up the twice he's tried; beatable under a hefty impost.

Was flying it in handicap chases last year, from an opening perch of 116; jumping went to pot when only 13-2 for Cheltenham's Paddy Power and tailed off in Topham in April; not sure to appreciate the contours of this track, but trip will suit if he handles it.

Winner over hurdles and fences in these colours when with Willie Mullins; last three runs have been poor, including stable debut hurdling; hood back on but yet to convince with his jumping (can go left); handicap debut.

Cost plenty from France where she was a dual chase winner and fair fifth in a 4yo Grade 1 over 2m6f; ran well on stable debut at Ayr in April where 2m looked too sharp; a most interesting contender, and similarly interesting riding arrangement; could have a class edge over most of these, if she's right.
Poor strike rate over fences and has been beaten miles in his last three handicaps; well held over Hurdles here yesterday.

Latest of three wins over fences was in 2024, but ran well on the flat a couple of times this summer and chasing second at Killarney was encouraging too; Danny Mullins on board for just the second time.
Won a nice pot over 2m1f at Fairyhouse in November, but it's been all downhill since and he's now 4lb lower than that last winning mark.

Dual winning hunter has taken well to handicaps and the form of his fluent-jumping Wexford win is very solid; second was only beaten 7l in the Plate and third almost won next time; stays farther, but might just prefer an easier finish than this punishing climb.

Quirky customer won over fences at Wexford last summer and is unexposed as a chaser; okay run over hurdles last time, and small chance if they've got his confidence back (didn't want to know about jumping on his last run over fences).

Course maiden hurdle winner was over-faced several times over fences after winning a Roscommon novice which fell apart last summer; has the beating of Blood Destiny on Listowel running two runs back, and little wrong with his 6l fourth to Lisleigh Lad on handicap debut at Wexford, where he didn't quite see it out over a furlong farther.
Disappointing in Mayo National at Ballinrobe and held by a couple of these on latest Wexford fifth; crack conditional being on board will help his chance, and is back down to a nice mark.

Owned by Galway people but hasn't clicked here yet, although has run well over hurdles at this venue;  last win was over similar trip at last year's Listowel festival, but 8lb higher now because he's well out of the handicap.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Six-time AW winner for Alice Haynes; out of form for new stable this year (five runs) but took step back in right direction when respectable sixth in this grade at Thirsk (1m, good to firm) last month and may benefit from this drop back in trip.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Looked unlucky not to win or go close when third on turf return here (1m, soft) in June, and again ran well in this grade when third at Lingfield (7.6f, good to firm) last month; may not be ideally suited by this shorter trip but still features prominently in calculations.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Bettered low-key seasonal/stable debut when fourth in Brighton handicap in June but finished down the field in this grade at Lingfield (also 7f, good to firm) last month; now tries cheekpieces; not easy to predict.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: A maiden after 28 starts, with tendencies to start slowly and race too freely, but has made the frame on his last five appearances, including two seconds in this grade at Brighton (6f, good to firm) this summer; fine over 7f and a likely contender once again; has tried various headgear combinations this year; goes in just the refitted cheekpieces today.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Unplaced all eight starts; belied 100-1 odds when fourth in this grade at Lingfield (7f, good to firm) 11 days ago, her second run for Micky Fenton, but needs to build on that performance here.

RaceName: Bodhi - Exceeding Expectations In Construction Classified Stakes
Spotlight: Low-mileage filly who made quite promising seasonal/handicap debut when fourth at Leicester (7f, good to firm) in May and may not have been suited by the soft ground when sixth (behind Nicely Curved) in this grade here (1m) in June; might be the answer.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: 3-3 this season and is an improved performer; followed her Duke of Cambridge win at Royal Ascot with a first top-flight success in the Falmouth, where she had too much foot for Precise; this flatter track won't inconvenience and she is the one to beat in a race lacking in depth.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Exposed performer who has won three of her 12 starts; ran to her best when winning a Listed event over C&D last time but she'll need a big jump forward if she's to figure at the finish.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Fourth to Fallen Angel in this race last year and looked an improved performer when successful in a Listed event over 7f at Longchamp on her reappearance; below that level in the Duke of Cambridge at Royal Ascot and, although she's better than that, she has something to find with the principals.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Turned in her best effort when beating Gaga Girl in a Listed event on testing ground at Longchamp in May; considerably more needed if she's to follow up in this company.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Stepped up on her juvenile form when winning the Group 3 Grotte (in front of a disappointing Green Spirit) on her reappearance and registered a pb when second to True Love in the 1,000 Guineas; didn't stay 10.5f in the Diane but, although faring better back at 1m in the Falmouth, has work to do to reverse placings with Blue Bolt and Precise.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Smart juvenile who was placed in the Rockfel before disappointing in the Fillies' Mile, both runs in cheekpieces; posted a career-best effort with that equipment left off when fourth to Precise in the Coronation Stakes on her reappearance; should be better for that run and has minor place claims.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Disappointed behind True Love in the 1,000 Guineas at Newmarket but made amends in the Irish equivalent, reversing placings with that rival; followed up in the Coronation Stakes at Royal Ascot but found Blue Bolt too quick in the Falmouth; this track could suit but a pb needed if she is to reverse placings with the Balding filly.

RaceName: Prix Rothschild - Fonds Europeen de l'Elevage - World Pool By PMU (Group 1) (Fillies & Mares) (Turf)
Spotlight: Best effort when close second to Diamond Necklace in last year's Marcel Boussac but beaten further by that rival in the Pouliches and didn't stay 10.5f in the Diane; return to 1m should suit but work to do if she's to compete with the two market leaders on these terms.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Won the corresponding race 12 months ago off a 10lb lower mark; as good as ever when fourth of eight at Wolverhampton (7f, Listed) in March but has found it tougher going since; apprentice's claim is useful but he still has little margin for error off this mark.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Group 3 win in Germany (6f, soft) last August; not at his best this year but the handicapper is cutting him some slack; stamina for 7f, even around here, has to be taken on trust.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Eight course wins to his name, the latest in May (5f, good) off a 2lb lower mark; had form over 7f in his youth but this year's two C&D runs haven't been convincing.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Three 7f wins in 2025; impressive dropped to 6f at Newcastle in March but he disappointed as favourite back at Newcastle five weeks ago; the penultimate performance suggests this mark is well within his range, and he could resume his progress back at 7f.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Produced a smart turn of foot to defy a wide draw in a C&D handicap in May; unplaced twice since but her potential hasn't been dimmed, looking stretched by the trip on rain-softened ground at Epsom and then doing best of her group at Royal Ascot; drawn widest again but this mark is unlikely to prove beyond her.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Yet to win a handicap but he is easing down the weights and his stable debut at York (1m, good to firm) was encouraging; well drawn back at 7f and he's one to consider.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Ex-French 4yo; three runs for Ian Williams have resulted in two heavy defeats either side of an eyecatching C&D effort in May; won't be far away if back at that level.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
OwnerName: Fine Claret Racing,Mrs Burke & C Wood
Spotlight: On a long losing run but he has dropped to a dangerous mark and his latest Newcastle run confirmed he retains a good chunk of ability, surging to the front 1f out but failing to see out the stiff 7f; this easier test should suit and he can't be discounted.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Won twice on AW (6f) as a 2yo; his best run this season came at Chester when a close second over 7.6f at the May meeting; good third at Hamilton last month (first run after a gelding operation); each-way shout.

RaceName: Disney's High School Musical At Lowry Handicap
Spotlight: Promiment racer who is well drawn to attack; three creditable runs here for his new stable in 2026 but others appeal as being better treated.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: All wins over 1m and was outpaced in the dip when third here on Tuesday; wide trip means that effort can be marked up, but 7f could be a bit sharp for him.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: D MacAuliffe, Anoj Don and Dahab Racing
Spotlight: Well-travelled and well-exposed 8yo is a long time winless; was running in stakes races in Dubai during the winter; held in handicap company in Britain last twice.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Smart 2yo mostly relegated to pacemaking duties this season, although penultimate start in Curragh Group 2 was decent; last in the Sussex on Wednesday having done his job, and is the complete opposite of one who has been laid out for this.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Course specialist won this in 2023 and third in last two renewals; lacked a prep outing before his run here on Tuesday where he backpedalled tamely; draw has been kind for one with his run-style, but he's pushing on and looks opposable.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Infrequent winner but got it done over this trip at Cork and was strong-travelling second in this last year; luckless run when sixth over 1m here on Tuesday and the 'champ' takes over in the saddle.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Got all the gaps down the inner when winning the big 1m handicap here on Tuesday, with seven of these behind; has loads of gears and likely to be ridden similarly from widest draw; 7lb penalty.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: N W T Dalzell/James Morgan/Karl Kirwan/Mrs John Murphy
Spotlight: Good record over 6f on straight tracks and on easy ground; was second in C&D nursery at two, but there will probably be stronger finishers up the hill; jockey is one to watch.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Yard stalwart weakened right out of it behind Orandi here on Tuesday and hard to fancy; tongue-tie tried.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Yet to win for this yard, but handicapper slow enough to relent; fair fourth to Gleneagle Bay at Cork in June; first time here, which will be an eye-opener for him.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
OwnerName: J Fairhurst & Damian McCann & Cyril McMullan
Spotlight: Progressive and consistent sprinter until latest run at the Curragh; 6f looks his optimum; placed effort over 7f on AW doesn't mean he's sure to get up the hill here.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Unplaced in two runs at last year's festival and fell out of the traps when always behind over 1m here on Tuesday; looks risky after that and best form is at a mile.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Four wins in France, including AW Listed contest over 7f; 50s, showed nothing in first two Irish starts.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Unexposed and progressive; won well at the Curragh on Derby weekend and fine second to Orandi when favourite here on Tuesday; had a decent run through then, and no real excuses; first time to drop back to 7f, and it's not sure to suit him as well as a mile.

RaceName: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Ahonoora Handicap (Premier Handicap)
Spotlight: Won over 1m here last year, in lower grade; well beaten behind Orandi and co here on Tuesday and hard to fancy.

Safely held an Newmarket on last two outings but this race is easier and she's now only 3lb higher than for breakthrough win at Nottingham (8.3f, good) in May; also suited by fast ground; dangerous if back on song.

A maiden after 12 runs but came from behind to go close in first-time blinkers at Chepstow (7f, good to firm) in June and also ran well when fourth at Doncaster (1m, good to firm) last month; could have a say.

Just a respectable fourth when upped to 1m2f (from about 7f) for recent handicap debut at Beverley but didn't have ideal track position there; drops back to 1m with cheekpieces tried here; should still have potential.

Scored over C&D (good to firm) on seasonal debut in April and was seemingly back in peak form when close third of four in tactical C&D contest ten days ago; not one to rely upon heavily but enters calculations.
Well down the field in her first two handicaps (5f/6f) but moves back up in trip and drops in grade here; still unexposed; worth a glance in the betting.
Showed some glimmers of promise in her qualifying races but was in rear throughout her recent handicap debut at Wolverhampton (8.6f, AW) and clearly needs a much more dynamic performance here.

Won races for two previous yards and was a close third on debut for current one (1m1f, good to firm); hasn't kicked on from there, including here two runs back when beating one home over 6f; drops into a claimer but these terms aren't easy.

Consistent since leaving Willie Mullins, performing well in handicaps from 6f to 1m; York last time wasn't necessarily a backward step as he wasn't beaten all that far in a big field after finding trouble in running; solid chance now into a claimer; first run here.

OwnerName: J Morley D Reynolds C Watkins & Partner
Spotlight: All wins have been over further when hooded and he's 0-7 at about 7f (has placed form); hasn't really fired in any of his last three races but this is easier than he's accustomed to; unraced at Chester.

The last run wasn't his best (four ran) but he was bang there in his four previous races, all handicaps at 7f/1m; drops into a claimer on favourable terms and must have every chance; has run well here before.
Third in a C&D handicap last month but that's been about it since joining this stable; now visored and doesn't have obvious claims on these terms.

OwnerName: James Paul Services To Industry Ltd
Spotlight: Won on debut for Joseph O'Brien; his only effort of note in six starts for current yard (two here) was last month's selling win at Beverley (extended 1m) when odds-on in beating two rivals (in this first-time headgear); back in a handicap last time and was found wanting, albeit over 1m2f; others preferred.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Yet to beat a rival and gets a mark after this.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 50s, no show at Leopardstown last month.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: 66s when around 9l behind runner-up Star Glory at Leopardstown last month.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Had run in a barrier trial before sixth at Leopardstown, where she was off the bridle before the straight over 7f; wants farther, but will be keeping on up the hill.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Space Traveller newcomer cost 8,000euro as a yearling; half-brother to three winners out of 7f AW winner; very much the second string for yard.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
OwnerName: Ms Lisa Sheridan & Patrick M O'Brien & Larry Murray
Spotlight: Looked as green as grass before flying home from rear (fully 12l off the pace 2f out) to be beaten less than a length at Down Royal on second start; definitely has an engine and the hill will suit.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Late headway when two places, and two lengths, off Someday Somewhere at Leopardstown where the winner was in a different county; not out of this.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: The most experienced of these and runner-up over 7f at right-handed tracks last twice; obvious chance.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Improved from Curragh debut to be close second over this trip at Leopardstown (first three were clear and third has gone in since); has given trouble in the stalls, but was better in that regard last time.

RaceName: Irish EBF Auction Series Maiden (IRE Incentive Race)
Spotlight: Was 9s and quietly fancied when third at Leopardstown on debut, 2l in front of Whosinterviewinwho; winner was different gravy, but it was still a decent start to her career.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)
Spotlight: Free-goer who won over 1m for Andrew Balding last summer and looked back in good nick when running big race in defeat over that trip here (good to firm) in May; refused to settle and came last of five (albeit not beaten that far) when upped to 1m2f at Lingfield in June, though, and remains risky over this trip.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)
Spotlight: Consistent colt who opened account at tenth attempt, with narrow success in small field here (11.5f, good to firm) last month; nudged up only 2lb for that and this drop back in trip won't be a problem; ought to be right in the thick of things again.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)
Spotlight: Well handicapped on some of last year's form for Alice Haynes that includes a fast-ground C&D win but has not been competitive on any of four starts for new stable this season (cheekpieces refitted last time); considered only if lively in the betting.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)
Spotlight: Seven-race maiden; has mixed record but gave good account when third of five in higher-grade race here (1m, good to firm; first-time hood) last month; could have a say if stamina holds out over this new trip.

RaceName: Bodhi Solutions - Commercial Fit-Out Challenge "Confined" Handicap (One Win Or Less In Flat Races)
Spotlight: Just held on to win tactical race at Newmarket (1m4f, good to firm) in June and seemed to respond well to first-time cheekpieces when clear second to revitalised rival over C&D (good to firm) on Tuesday; commands respect.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has been around the block and mostly seen on the AW these days; he did win on debut for this yard at Ripon (1m, good; by a head) but then finished last at Sandown four days ago; unplaced in one previous run here.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Perhaps best over further but he was only nabbed late on over C&D last week and, although 1lb higher, Toby Moore rides him for the first time claiming 7lb; can be inconsistent but he's run three excellent races in defeat around here; solid chance.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Progressive form under both codes last year included a 1m4f course win; quiet return to jumping at Cartmel two weeks ago but that was after a lengthy break and he's on better Flat mark than he is over hurdles.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Heavy-ground maiden winner for Paddy Twomey; hasn't got a lot going for current yard (four starts) and cheekpieces tried last time are soon removed; it could be that he'll show more when the ground softens up.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Ex-French 4yo who has raced seven times for Ian Williams and encouragingly the best of those efforts was his latest when beaten half a length from the back at Doncaster (1m4f, good to soft); back up 2lb; unraced on firmer than good; fair chance provided conditions don't hold him back.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: AW winner over 7f for previous yard off 3lb higher; signs of getting it together for Ian Williams, albeit those were Class 5 handicaps at Chepstow and over 1m; down 1lb and, if he can see out the trip, wouldn't be without hope.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Has competitive course form, including a respectable fourth over the extended 7f in June; this is more his trip but he needs to bounce back from two forgettable runs at 1m4f (here) and 9.4f (AW).

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
OwnerName: Nbr30, Mike Owen & Rasio Cymru Racing
Spotlight: 0-8 since his winning debut here last September (7f); last two runs have also been here at about 7f and neither was wildly encouraging (in cheekpieces then an eyeshield); bit to prove, including stamina for this far.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: No course form but acts on good and faster ground; it took six races to get off the mark, when odds-on over an extended 1m3f at Lingfield in June, and he proved very disappointing when a shade of odds-on for last month's handicap debut at Newmarket (1m4f; beaten 18l); now goes in cheekpieces and he could be given another chance, especially as the horse he beat in his novice has won since.

RaceName: Tom Jones Live At Chester Racecourse Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
Spotlight: Exposed 6yo who excels at Wolverhampton where's he won five times and yet on turf he's 1-19; close fourth on his favourite patch 12 days ago and 4lb lower back on the grass, but he wouldn't be the percentage call on first visit here.

Claimed after Naas success last September and fine yard debut effort following month when second in Leopardstown nursery; seemingly ridden to stay 1m2f trip on seasonal return at Roscommon in late June, staying on into fourth under today's rider; back in trip here but softer ground will suit and can go well.
Promising Navan debut run (1m2f, yielding) hasn't been replicated in two starts since, not getting home last time over 1m4f; back markedly in trip here for handicap debut with Billy Lee booked.

Debuted at Listed level last year and hasn't really got competitive in both maidens this term, latest in steadily-run 1m4f Limerick fillies' contest last month; back in trip here for handicap debut with likely more to offer.

Debut 6f maiden win at Sligo last August sole success from seven starts, although recent Navan third (1m2f) under a positive ride was more encouraging; visor now replaces cheekpieces and drops in trip; could go well if handling softer ground.
Improvement since switched from AW, third in Leopardstown maiden (yielding-to-soft) and never-nearer fifth on handicap debut at Gowran, both over 1m; remains open to more improvement.

Runner-up in a heavy ground nursery here last October and again when only caught late by Nephin Mountain over 1m2f at Ballinrobe recently, having handled home turn much better than that rival; well below that form in first-time cheekpieces over C&D on Friday however, having not had a clear run.

Eyecatching third at Fairyhouse and backed that up by winning over C&D on Friday in first-time cheekpieces, asserting late on on yielding-to-soft; major chance if making quick return under mandatory 7lb penalty, although wide draw to contend with.
Roscommon winner on good ground with just okay form since off 5lb higher; bit to find with Jp's Express on latest Fairyhouse run. although has been dropped 2lb.
Just held on over 7f at Limerick two starts back; never counted (tight for room early on) here on Monday and of limited appeal from 3lb out of handicap.
Mildly promising Cork debut in May but two poor runs since; 4lb wrong on handicap debut, but rider's claim negates that.
Off the mark at the eleventh attempt when just getting up to beat Aquilla Star at Ballinrobe (1m2f) last month, having run wide home turn; 4lb wrong here and wide draw to overcome.

RaceName: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: 0-31 on turf but scored off 3lb higher on AW in December and returned from ten-week break with pretty good third in 0-70 grade at Doncaster (5f, good to firm) last month; major player in this grade.

RaceName: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Won seven sprints when trained by Dylan Cunha and didn't run badly when tried over 1m here last month, after which he changed hands for 16,000gns; makes stable debut from a good mark but is on the downgrade now and 6f is probably his optimum trip; tongue tied for first time.

RaceName: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Largely consistent for new stable this year and was close second off today's mark at Chepstow (5f, good to firm) on penultimate appearance; unlucky not to finish closer to the target when third of four there last time and has the services of Tom Marquand here; good chance.

RaceName: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
Spotlight: Nothing like the force of old but rediscovered some form and ran well from the front when close third in Nottingham classified (5f, good to firm) last month; has possibilities if in similar mood again here.

RaceName: Price Bailey LLP Norwich "Confined" Handicap (For Horses Which Have Not Won A Flat Race In 2026)
